notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Rime Tender.
Rime Tender does not have summoning sickness.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
description:
Activate a permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Rimefeather Owl by paying {1}{S}, putting a snow counter on the mana producing permanent, causing the permanent to become a snow permanent.
Activate Rime Tender by tapping it, untapping the mana producing permanent.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Rime Tender.
Activate the permanent with the snow counter on it by tapping it, adding at least {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
